info.title: MyOme API
info.description:
The MyOme API enables clients to:
- List sequencing and analysis products available to the client.
- Submit requisitions for sequencing for new samples.
- Check status of requisitions and orders.
- Retrieve order results, including sequencing data, structured interpretation
  data, and PDF reports.

# API Overview

## Terminology

- A *Product* is a specific assay or intepretation service. Product
  identifiers begin with `PR`.
- A *Requisition* is a request for one or more Products for a single sample.
  Requisition identifiers begin with `RQ`.
- An *Order* is
  a request for a specific service for a specific sample.  An Order is created for each
  Product requested in a Requisition Order identifiers
  begin with `OR`.   
- A *Report* is the end result of a successful Order. An Order typically has one
  associated Report, but may have zero in the case of failure or multiple in
  the case of amended or corrected reports.

## Typical flow

- Client obtains JWT from auth.myome.com. All of the following interactions with the MyOme API include
  this JWT for authorization (details below).
- Client sends a requisition to MyOme with product ID(s). Each product will generate a distinct order attached to that requisition. 
  The MyOme API returns a MyOme requisition id.
- Client fetches information about the Requisition. The response includes an order id for each Order placed.
- Client fetches information about each Order. The response includes the status and, if
  available, links to results.

## Order Statuses

Order status:
- SUBMITTED - Order has been received
- DENIED - Denied by physician of record (only relevant for patient-initiated testing requests)
- CANCELED - Order was canceled
- AWAITING_SAMPLE - Sample has not arrived yet
- ANALYZING - Order is being processed
- CLINICIAN_REVIEW - Order results sent to clinician and waiting for review
- COMPLETED - Order has been completed

# API Conventions

## Authorization

All endpoints require authorization using JSON Web Tokens (JWT) using the header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. `<token>` is a JWT generated using Keycloak with partner-specific credientials. 
Note that the token refreshes every hour. MyOme will provide credentials to partners via secure email during account creation. Those credentials should be kept confidential.

## HTTP Status Codes

The MyOme API uses the following standard HTTP status codes to indicate the success or failure
of an API request.

    200 Success
    201 Created
    204 No Content
    400 Bad Request
    401 Unauthorized
    403 Forbidden
    404 Resource Not Found
    415 Unsupported Media Type
    500 Internal Server Error

A successful create request returns 201 Created along with the created object identifier. A successful
update request returns 200 OK along with the updated object. An unsuccessful API request returns
a relevant HTTP status code along with an error response.

schema.description:
Request body for the Natera redraw endpoint.

Conditional requirements (enforced server-side):
  * When `natera_case_id` is a non-empty string, `order_date` and
    `samples` are required.
  * When `natera_case_id` is `null`, missing, or empty, the case id
    is cleared from the requisition. `samples` must be empty or
    omitted in that case, but `remove_samples` is still allowed and
    `order_date`, if omitted, leaves the requisition's existing
    order date unchanged.

ordering_provider.description:
Embedded ordering provider details. Use this instead of
`ordering_provider_npi` when the provider may not yet exist at the
clinic. If the NPI does not resolve to a verified provider, MyOme
verifies it against the NPPES registry. On a successful match the
provider is created/used as verified and the requisition proceeds
normally. If verification cannot be completed automatically, the
requisition is accepted (HTTP 202) with
`provider_verification_status: PENDING` and held for manual review.

provider_verification_status.description:
Verification state of the ordering provider for requisitions
created with an embedded `ordering_provider`. `VERIFIED` means the
provider was matched/verified and the order proceeds normally.
`PENDING` means the provider could not be verified automatically;
the requisition is accepted (HTTP 202) and held for manual review.

provider.

counseling was requested.

`appointment_url` and `access_code` are used independently, not combined into a
single URL: open `appointment_url` directly (do not append the code as a query
param) to view or manage the appointment, and present `access_code` to the
patient to enter on DNAvisit's scheduling site.
